target.notes: Mounted using only components MUI exports, with default configuration and no hand-written ARIA. MUI's documentation asks the developer to supply several ARIA attributes themselves, aria-labelledby on Dialog, and aria-haspopup / aria-controls / aria-expanded on a Menu's trigger button. Those are not supplied here, because writing them would measure our transcription of MUI's docs rather than what MUI ships. Tab panels come from @mui/lab, since @mui/material exports no tab panel component.

assertions.title: The menu button has an accessible name
assertions.rationale: An unlabelled menu button is announced as just a button, giving no indication of what it opens.

assertions.title: The menu button declares that it opens a menu
assertions.rationale: aria-haspopup is what warns a screen reader user that activating this button opens something, rather than performing an action.
assertions.detail: The menu button does not declare that it opens a menu.

assertions.title: aria-expanded is present and false before the menu opens
assertions.rationale: Without it the user is not told the menu is currently shut, only that something can be opened.
assertions.detail: The collapsed menu button does not expose aria-expanded="false".

assertions.title: Enter opens the menu
assertions.rationale: The primary activation key. If it does nothing, the menu is unreachable by keyboard.

assertions.title: Down Arrow opens the menu
assertions.rationale: APG requires Down Arrow to open the menu and move to its first item, which is how most keyboard users reach it.
assertions.detail: The menu did not open when Down Arrow was pressed on the focused button.

assertions.title: aria-expanded becomes true when the menu opens
assertions.rationale: A sighted user sees the menu appear. Without the state change a screen reader user is never told it did.
assertions.detail: The menu button does not expose aria-expanded="true" while its menu is open.

assertions.title: The popup exposes role=menu
assertions.rationale: The menu role is what makes the popup navigable as a menu rather than announced as a list of links.

assertions.title: Each item exposes role=menuitem
assertions.rationale: Without it a screen reader cannot count the items, announce position, or offer menu navigation shortcuts.
assertions.detail: All three items expose a menuitem role.

assertions.title: Opening the menu moves to its first item
assertions.rationale: This is the difference between a menu and a dropdown. If nothing becomes active on open, a keyboard user is left with a visible menu they cannot enter.
assertions.detail: First item active via DOM focus.

assertions.title: Down Arrow moves to the next item
assertions.rationale: Without arrow navigation a keyboard user can reach the first item and nothing beyond it.

assertions.title: Escape closes the menu
assertions.rationale: The learned way out. Without it a user who opened the menu by accident is stuck in it.

assertions.title: Closing the menu returns focus to the button
assertions.rationale: Focus was moved into the menu on open. If it is not handed back on close, the user is dropped to the top of the document and loses their place.

assertions.title: Each item has an accessible name
assertions.rationale: An unnamed menu item is announced as an empty menuitem and cannot be chosen deliberately.
assertions.detail: All three items expose their label.
